skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and principles of macroeconomics, including national income, inflation, unemployment, financial systems, and monetary systems.
Apply basic economic models to analyze and evaluate the impact of macroeconomic policies on the economy.
Develop skills in logical reasoning, problem-solving, and critical thinking to address fundamental macroeconomic issues.
Enhance abilities in independent research, teamwork, and creative thinking to solve practical problems.
Foster self-study and continuous learning to deepen understanding of macroeconomic issues.
Understand basic concepts of financial management, including savings, investments, financial markets, and risk management.
Analyze the role of monetary policy in stabilizing the economy.
Analyze the role of fiscal policy in stabilizing the economy.
Understand the factors affecting economic growth and the role of government policies.
Analyze the causes and effects of inflation.
Understand the types and measures of unemployment and the impact of policies on unemployment.
Analyze the relationship between supply and demand in the context of macroeconomic policies.
